 Honor 700 devices teased to come with an interesting feature on the rear screen
 Post your comment

 Vlad 
 09 November 2026 
 Honor Android 
 A few days ago, Honor officially revealed the design of the upcoming 700, 700 Pro , and 700S. All three phones will have a rear display inside the camera plateau, and interestingly, this screen will be able to show your heart rate and blood oxygen level.
 This has been inferred from the latest teaser image put out by the brand for the series, which shows the heart rate and blood oxygen level. That said, Honor hasn’t specifically confirmed this feature yet. That also means that we can't be sure how exactly it will work.
 Obviously, there needs to be a sensor on there somewhere, which will take the readings. That might be what we see above the oval-shaped multi-LED flash on this phone's back, but, again, this hasn't been officially confirmed.
 According to famous Chinese leaker Digital Chat Station, the back display of the 700 series will also be able to work like a viewfinder if you want to take selfies with the rear cameras. Additionally, you'll apparently be able to play mini games on it and get notifications.
 Honor says all three devices in this lineup will be offered in Blue Tone, Cold White, Clear Sky, and Pink Mist colors. According to past leaks, the Honor 700 will be powered by the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 SoC, while the 700 Pro will use the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5. Both should have a periscope telephoto camera too, with teleconverter support even. The Pro specifically is said to have a 6.57-inch screen and a 9,000 mAh battery.
